2026-11-03.title: US Strikes Iranian Island Ahead of Midterm Elections

2026-11-03.facts: Reddit and an Australian digital rights group are taking the government to court over a new law that bans children under 16 from using major social media platforms. The challengers argue the restriction violates constitutional rights to free expression and access to information.

2026-11-03.facts: The Trump administration is preparing to roll back parts of a Biden-era law that was designed to help pregnant women stay in the workforce. 2026-11-03.title: Michigan Voters to Weigh In on Trump's Trade War at the Polls
2026-11-03.facts: President Trump's tariff strategy is facing a real-world test in Michigan, where voters head to the polls with trade policy squarely on their minds. 2026-11-03.facts: Britain and the European Union have agreed to a draft deal that would eliminate a significant chunk of the bureaucratic burden that's been choking food exports since Brexit. 2026-11-03.title: Nasdaq-100 Slides Into Third Correction of the Year

2026-11-04.title: World Leaders Grapple With Trump's Midterm Losses
2026-11-04.facts: World leaders and commentators are trying to decode what President Trump's electoral losses in the midterms will mean for their countries. 2026-11-04.title: England Trials Multi-Cancer Blood Test in Primary Care
